command_or_source: App commit 0d643704b1f84d83dad145624be88e5bfe05a483: bash scripts/test.sh (testTocodeCommandExecutorMapping, testTocodeCLIRunnerAndIPC, testWeChatCommandConsumption).
result_summary: Memory IPC transport drives the CLI runner-to-executor chain with returned result text; WeChat mock sends .lshp/.blackout/plain messages and asserts command replies plus no wechat*.md writes for command messages, while plain messages continue to archive normally.
limitations: WeChat command routing uses a mock transport and archiver rather than the real iLink client.
CLI integration uses an injected in-memory transport instead of the real socket.
